thread:
kevin: quick heads-up — RC1 cutoff is tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need a quick pass: version bump, changelog sweep, and annotated tag + GH draft. who can own tagging?

maria: I can take changelog and run the version bump in the release branch. will push a PR in ~30m.

oliver: I can do annotated tag + draft release once artifacts are confirmed. ping me when builds are uploaded.

kevin: thanks. @oliver when you do the tag use the signed annotated tag pattern we used last time: `git tag -s -a v1.12.0-rc1 -m "v1.12.0-rc1"` then `git push origin v1.12.0-rc1`. add checksum in the release body.

sasha: deploy-bot just reported the artifact pipeline:
```
deploy-bot: build/rc1/artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-releases/rc1/ (sha256 manifest attached)
```

deploy-bot: artifacts available: build.tar.gz (sha256: a3f5...), linux-x86_64.bin (sha256: b9c2...).

maria: copying checksums into changelog PR now. Small note: we bumped a dependency patch in release branch — I left a note in the PR for QA to double-check logs.

oliver: quick question — do we want a separate draft for the RC or update the existing draft for v1.12.0? I can create an "RC" suffix in the release name to avoid accidental publish.

kevin: create a distinct draft named "v1.12.0-rc1 (staging)" and set it to Draft. we should not accidentally publish it. good call.

maria: PR for changelog & version bump -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 (WIP). CI passing for docs and changelog lint.

oliver: I'll wait for your merge, then tag from the merge commit. plan: create annotated tag, push, open GH draft, attach checksums and binary links, then leave it for release lead to flip from Draft -> Publish later.

sasha: quick verification: can someone confirm the signed key path? last time we used /secrets/release-key-prod on the release CI runner.

kevin: yes still that key. oliver — if you can't sign locally, use the release CI job: `./ci/release/sign_and_push.sh v1.12.0-rc1`. it will sign with the mounted key and push the tag.

oliver: perfect. i'll run the CI job after the changelog merge. I'll post the draft URL here when ready. :shipit:

maria: merged changelog & bumped to 1.12.0-rc1. CI green.

deploy-bot: release job queued -> ci/release/sign_and_push v1.12.0-rc1 (triggered by oliver).

oliver: tagged and draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/releases/tag/v1.12.0-rc1-draft (attached artifacts + checksums). leaving as Draft.

kevin: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll run a quick smoke on staging and report back before we hand to QA. if any blocker call it out here.

sasha: I'll kick off the regression suite once kevin gives the ok.

kevin: smoke ok. no obvious regressions. handing to QA. :thumbsup:

maria: noted and adding a short changelog blurb to the draft release body.

oliver: marking thread resolved from tagging side. will un-draft only when release lead gives explicit publish permission.

kevin: perfect. closing loop — thanks all.
